# External corpus staging
El Yafrani, Sung, Nielsen (2021), Problem Instances for the Generalized Assignment Problem (GAP) with Resource-Independent Task Profits and Identical Resource Capacity, DOI https://doi.org/10.17632/njyxh337cc.1, source https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/njyxh337cc/1, CC BY 4.0 verified on publisher dataset page. Archive downloaded locally, exact published SHA256 verified, 1080 instance directories, 54 generated benchmark classes. Local archive /root/uadie-external-g24.sJNPO0/data-gen.zip, no raw redistribution. Generated external benchmark, not operational industrial data. Metadata describes resource capacities, per-resource task loads, task profits. Decimal values require exact rational-to-integer row scaling and numeric envelope checks. Full original publication model (notably optional vs mandatory task assignment) must be confirmed before claiming benchmark equivalence. No optimization results yet; do not count acquired instances as tested or admitted. Source paper DOI https://doi.org/10.1080/0305215X.2021.1940991. Bonn flow DOI https://doi.org/10.60507/FK2/5IKK7K is CC BY-NC 4.0 and remains excluded. Other external data sources not acquired.
